title: Basic hiragana: R and W rows and ん — write in kana
description: Use Latin-letter syllable cues to recall and type the matching hiragana signs. Kana answers only; no sign is displayed in the question.

exercises.prompt: From the Latin-letter cue below, recall and type its hiragana spelling (not romaji).

stimulus.translation: Latin-letter cue for the basic hiragana ra sign.

text.gloss: Hiragana sign for the basic ra reading.

exercises.explanation: The hiragana spelling for the cue ra is ら. Hiragana sign for the basic ra reading. Only this authored kana spelling is accepted; this is not a pronunciation-equivalence test.
